streamer mode.title: Streamer Mode Toggle
streamer mode.body:
Enables live broadcast integrations including Auto-Clip audio monitoring, Stream Director remote co-host connections, and Twitch Stream Markers.

Tip: Turn this OFF when you are not live to pause background audio capture and save CPU.

content creator mode.title: Content Creator Mode (Offline Production)
content creator mode.body: Unlocks Auto-Clip & timestamped Moments Logging (recording_moments.txt) for offline video recording without requiring Twitch live streaming or authentication.

moment bookmark.title: Recording Moment Bookmark Hotkey
moment bookmark.body: Drops an instant timestamped bookmark with your elapsed session time and active game/window title into recording_moments.txt and recording_moments.json.

highlight hotkey.title: Primary Alert Highlight Hotkey
highlight hotkey.body:
Global shortcut that flashes your selected monitor's border overlay to grab attention.

You can bind keyboard chords, mouse side buttons, or gamepad combos here or in the Unified Hotkeys & Peripherals tab — both stay synced automatically.

launchpad.title: Stream Launchpad & Mission Control
launchpad.body:
Your pre-flight broadcast checklist and 1-Click 'GO FOR LAUNCH' trigger.

Verifies OBS/Streamlabs connection, starts Chronos timers, enables Rotating Text, and takes your stream live in one action.

stream director.title: Stream Director & Remote Co-Host
stream director.body: Allows trusted remote co-hosts or moderators to switch scenes, mute audio tracks, adjust faders, and optionally control recording over encrypted P2P WebRTC with granular per-element permissions.

auto-clip.title: Auto-Clip & Stream Markers
auto-clip.body: Monitors your microphone or VoiceMeeter input in real time to detect hype moments and automatically drop Twitch Stream Markers or offline recording bookmarks.

soundboard.title: Soundboard & Anti-Spam Troll Shield
soundboard.body: Plays local audio cues and lets authorized remote directors trigger sounds. Includes rate-limiting and panic lock protection against rapid-fire spam.

chronos.title: Chronos Live Stream Timers
chronos.body: Multi-timer suite supporting Countdowns, Stopwatches, and Interval timers with automatic OBS/SLOBS text file output (timer_display.txt).

rotating text.title: Rotating Text & Trivia Cycler
rotating text.body: Automatically cycles rules, sponsor shoutouts, social links, or interactive Trivia Q&A to an OBS/SLOBS text file on a configurable schedule.

audio devices.title: Audio Devices & Routing
audio devices.body: Master hub for selecting your Windows WASAPI microphone/VoiceMeeter capture device and your Soundboard/Alert playback output device. Changes sync across all tabs.

monitor setup.title: Multi-Monitor Configuration
monitor setup.body: Select which physical display receives the border alert overlay and configure DPI awareness mode for mixed-resolution multi-monitor setups.

hotkeys.title: Unified Hotkeys & Peripherals
hotkeys.body: Central binding manager for keyboard chords, Mouse 3/4/5, and XInput gamepads. Supports hold thresholds and multi-button release shielding. Changes sync two-way with individual tabs.
